content:
Maria: deploybot reported promotion failure for release/2026-03-23 (commit a1b2c3). Staging smoke failed and logs show an artifact checksum mismatch when fetching the image. tagging @olivia @sam for release decision.

deploybot: Promotion failed at 1716004321. Error: artifact fetch checksum mismatch. Candidate image: sha256:abc123, expected: sha256:def456. Job: ci/staging/e2e#542. Full logs: https://ci.internal/reports/542 (permissioned).

Sam: re-ran the staging job manually, but it failed early with a cache read error — looks like the runner couldn't fetch the blob. paste of the tail:
```
ERROR: failed to fetch blob sha256:abc123: error reading from remote cache: GET https://registry.internal/v2/app-server/blobs/sha256:abc123 -> 502 Bad Gateway
Caused by: object checksum mismatch: got def456 vs expected abc123
```

Lee: this smells like the registry/objectstore handed us a corrupted blob or the CI publish step wrote the wrong checksum. we had a similar transient after the pruner run yesterday where some multipart uploads were left behind.

Olivia: change window in ~90m (22:00 UTC). We need a fast decision: pin to last-good image (minimal blast radius) or block the window while we investigate and try reuploading the artifact. Thoughts?

Maria: last-good prod image is sha256:prev789 (promoted 1715900000). Pinning unblocks the release fastest — we can then follow up with a rollback/rebuild flow for the broken artifact. If we attempt reupload now we risk missing the change window.

Sam: agree pin + reupload later. If we pin we should re-run canary tests before full promote. Canaries are ~10m. I'll also attempt to re-push the artifact to a mirror and compare checksums.

Lee: uploading again could fix it if the publish was flaky. But we need to determine if the CI artifact is malformed or the registry served a bad blob. Check the manifest sizes and digests: `skopeo inspect --raw docker://registry.internal/app-server:ci-a1b2c3` and compare `Content-Length` from storage. If sizes differ that's the registry.

Maria: consensus: pin to prev789 to unblock, run canaries, and open a ticket to fully triage artifact corruption. Olivia, do you want to own the release note entry?

Olivia: @Sam please run the promote to prev789 and start canaries. I'll add a release note entry: "Pinned to last-good image due to artifact checksum mismatch during staging; follow-up investigation tracked in INFR-4023." @deploybot — kick the promote with reason 'pin-after-checksum-mismatch'.

Sam: On it. Command: `deploybot promote --release release/2026-03-23 --image sha256:prev789 --reason "pin-after-checksum-mismatch"`

deploybot: promote job queued. Canary jobs: ci/prod/canary#1..3 started.

Sam: canaries all passed (3/3). Proceeding to full promotion.

deploybot: Promotion complete. prod now at sha256:prev789. Promotion timestamp: 1716004375.

Olivia: Release note added: "release/2026-03-23 pinned to last-good image due to CI artifact checksum mismatch. Investigation ticket: INFR-4023. Follow-up actions: re-upload artifact, verify publish checksums, add registry GC grace, add pre-promote checksum validation."

Maria: I opened INFR-4023 and attached logs, the `skopeo inspect` output, and the pruner run times. Suggested triage: 1) validate CI publish step (single-writer integrity), 2) add checksum verification on publish and before promote, 3) review pruner GC window.

Lee: also adding a short-term mitigation: bump registry GC grace by 1h and add a pre-promote `HEAD` check to deploybot that verifies blob digests for the manifest. I'll PR the change to deploybot later today.

Sam: thanks all. Closing the hold. :thumbsup:
